module.title: Platform Operations, Observability and Releases
module.business_purpose: The operational backbone a data-center-grade deployment requires. Governs the platform's tools/technologies and the build/release artifacts they produce, the logical service components that run in each environment, their deployments, and continuous health checks with append-only run history and derived incidents. Complements qa_lab (pre-release testing), telemetry (product analytics) and system_ops (data governance) with runtime operations & SRE evidence. No PHI.
